tasks.title: Second pro UX review on ux-pro1: details, flaws, improvements + feature proposals
tasks.brief: Owner Ahmed wants a deep second-round review of the NEW frontend (worker/live/nova-rx-preview.ux-pro1.js, includes UX1-UX20) focused on fine details and user experience, finding every remaining flaw and improvement, AND proposing product development ideas. Serve it locally (`npx wrangler dev --local` on the artifact, or the repo frontend via http-server); do NOT write to the live server. Reuse/extend tools/qa/ux-pro-audit.mjs (Playwright headless Chromium, desktop 1366x768 + mobile 390x844, fake data). Re-measure every journey from .nova/qa/ux-pro-report.md (quick sale by name/barcode, qty, discount, pay, print/sticker, return, purchase/receiving, stock + low-stock, debt collection, prescription/chronic, daily report, settings): clicks/keystrokes, time, transitions, perf (load, INP/long tasks, CLS). Verify each UX9-UX19 fix actually works; flag regressions. Then scrutinise details: micro-copy and Arabic wording, consistency of spacing/colours/typography/icons, alignment, RTL, empty/loading/error states, feedback after actions (toasts, sounds), undo, keyboard flow and focus, tap targets, contrast, printing layout, offline behaviour. Write .nova/qa/ux-pro2-report.md in Arabic: executive summary, before/after table per journey (الرحلة | قبل | دلوقتي | المستهدف | ملاحظات), prioritized findings (عالية/متوسطة/منخفضة) with screenshots in .nova/qa/ux-pro2/ (max ~40 small PNGs), and a separate section «اقتراحات تطوير» with 10-15 concrete feature ideas valuable for an Egyptian retail pharmacy (each: الفكرة، الفايدة، الجهد تقريبي S/M/L، frontend-only ولا محتاج backend). Then write .nova/inbox/ux-pro2.json = {"tasks":[...]} with one small frontend-only fix task per high/medium finding (group related, max 15), ids starting at UX22, each {id, phase:10, title, brief, acceptance, after:[]} with exact files + tests (include click-count assertions), preserve Black Edition Arabic RTL, backend frozen, no deploys; LAST item rebuilds worker/live/nova-rx-preview.ux-pro2.js like UX20 did, after = all other new ids, must NOT deploy. Feature proposals go ONLY in the report, not as tasks. Do not edit .nova/cloud-queue.json. Commit script changes, screenshots, report and inbox file on this branch.
tasks.acceptance: Arabic report .nova/qa/ux-pro2-report.md with before/after click counts, perf numbers, verified status of UX9-UX19, prioritized detail findings with screenshots, and a «اقتراحات تطوير» section; valid .nova/inbox/ux-pro2.json with UX22+ fix tasks and a final no-deploy ux-pro2 artifact rebuild task; no live writes, fake data only.
